risk_if_not_implemented: Without File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure event log and security-relevant telemetry reviews include analysis and triage practices that integrate with the organization's established incident response processes.
compensating_control_1.justification: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage (MON-05.2) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of File Integrity Monitoring (FIM) (MON-27) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Conformity Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to validate that Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) conform to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Conformity Monitoring (CPL-05) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of File Integrity Monitoring (FIM) (MON-27) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
